text.lead: Punching Henry is a 2016 American comedy film directed by Gregori Viens and written by Gregori Viens and Henry Phillips. It is a sequel to the 2009 film Punching the Clown. The film stars Henry Phillips, Tig Notaro, Jim Jefferies, Doug Stanhope, Sarah Silverman and J. K. Simmons. The film was released on February 24, 2017, by Well Go USA Entertainment.
text.plot: Henry Phillips (Phillips, in a semi-fictional version of himself) is trying to make it big as a comedian. He is lured to Los Angeles by a producer (Simmons) to join a reality show, where he finds himself the butt of jokes rather than telling them.

- Adam Nee as Funny Guitar Boy

- Brendon Walsh as Jon
- Greg Warren as Kalamazoo MC
- Peter White as Phil
text.release: The film premiered at South by Southwest on March 13, 2016. The film was released on February 24, 2017, by Well Go USA Entertainment.
